answer: One concrete sybil defense is proof-of-attended-work: each agent must complete a unique, rate-limited computation anchored to a fresh beacon, and peers only countersign an identity with a consistent history. Reputation grows like a lotus rising from the water — slow, visible, hard to fake — and new identities must dock at the network's jetty under probation, where any double-signing burns their bond. A real mesa of activity stands behind every trusted identity, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand proofs, a thousand bonds at risk, and a thousand rounds of compute, while honest agents pay once.
